heading.title: Incorporation of Limited Liability Partnership and Matters Incidental Thereto

article.title: Publication of name and limited liability.
article.content:
(1) Every limited liability partnership shall ensure that its invoices, official correspondence and publications bear the following, namely:—
(a) the name, address of its registered office and registration number of the limited liability partnership; and
(b) a statement that it is registered with limited liability.
1[(2) If the limited liability partnership contravenes the provisions of this section, the limited liability partnership shall be liable to a penalty of ten thousand rupees.]

21Publication of name and limited liability.

Section 21 · Chapter III · page 12 of the Act

(1) Every limited liability partnership shall ensure that its invoices, official correspondence and publications bear the following, namely:—

(a) the name, address of its registered office and registration number of the limited liability partnership; and

(b) a statement that it is registered with limited liability.

1[(2) If the limited liability partnership contravenes the provisions of this section, the limited liability partnership shall be liable to a penalty of ten thousand rupees.]

1 Subs. by Act 31 of 2021, s. 10, for sub-section (2) (w.e.f. 1-4-2022).
